task: Fix the off-by-one error in the pagination helper so the last page returns the remaining items instead of an empty array.
Add a refund endpoint that accepts an order id and amount, rejects duplicate refunds, and returns 201 on success.
Refactor the payment service to use a repository interface without changing observable behavior.
Reproduce and fix the intermittent login timeout caused by a missing session refresh under concurrent requests.
Migrate the orders table to add an idempotency key column with a rollback path.
Add a user notification preferences page with backend persistence and a toggle UI.
Add request tracing headers across the API gateway and two downstream services.
Fix the currency formatting bug where negative amounts show an extra minus sign.
Add a weekly report job that aggregates orders, sends an email, and records a run history row.
Refactor a monolith checkout module into a checkout service with API, persistence, and integration tests, preserving behavior.
